_comment: Auth mode: cookie-based (session cookie SAP). Dien cac field co <...>. Chay: mcp-sap-connect setup --from-file duong-dan-file-nay.json
_help_cookies: Lay tu browser da dang nhap he thong SAP: F12 -> Application/Storage -> Cookies -> copy tung cap name/value. Ten cookie thuong gap: MYSAPSSO2, SAP_SESSIONID_<SID>_<CLIENT>, sap-usercontext
_help_reauthMode: 'manual' = tu paste lai cookie moi khi het han (mac dinh, an toan nhat). 'auto' = tu mo browser cho dang nhap lai (can pip install "...[playwright]" + playwright install chromium)
_help_service: 1 trong 5: s4hc_(public) | s4hc_(private) | btp | onprem | rise_with_sap - xem README.md cung thu muc
